name: UAL 811 颠簸 雷暴绕飞 增压问题

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is UAL 811, from Los Angeles to Wuhan, you have received an Urgency call from AFR 103, AFR 103 had a pressurization problem and the cabin altitude was rising rapidly, relay the message to Zhengzhou Control.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你的呼号是 UAL 811，从洛杉矶飞往武汉，你收到 AFR 103 的紧急呼叫，AFR 103 出现增压问题且客舱高度快速上升，将该信息转报给郑州管制。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN, Zhengzhou Control, UAL 811, we have intercepted an Urgency call from AFR 103, AFR 103 had a pressurization problem and the cabin altitude was rising rapidly.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN PANPAN PANPAN，郑州管制，UAL 811，我们截收到 AFR 103 的紧急呼叫，AFR 103 出现增压问题，客舱高度快速上升。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 811, roger PANPAN, break, break, AFR 103, descend to 3000 meters on QNH1021.
B: You relay the message to AFR 103.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 811，收到 PANPAN，暂停，暂停，AFR 103，在 QNH 1021 上下降至 3000 米。
B： 你将该信息转发给 AFR 103。
cards.referenceText: AFR 103, UAL 811, roger PANPAN, descend to 3000 meters QNH 1021.
cards.referenceTextZh: AFR 103，UAL 811，收到 PANPAN，在 QNH 1021 上下降至 3000 米。

cards.audioText: UAL 811, offset 3 miles right of track, reduce speed to mach decimal 75 due radar failure.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 811，向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里，因雷达故障将速度减至 Mach 0.75。
cards.referenceText: offset tree miles right of track, reduce speed to mach decimal seven five, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 向航迹右侧偏置 3 英里，将速度减至 Mach 0.75，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: B: Your weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, request Zhengzhou Control for 20 miles deviation right of track and state the reason.
cards.audioTextZh: B：气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，向郑州管制请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里，并说明原因。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 811, our weather radar indicates there is a cumulonimbus ahead, request 20 miles deviation right of track.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 811，我们气象雷达显示前方有积雨云，请求向航迹右侧偏航 20 海里。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告。
cards.referenceText: 20 miles deviation to the right approved, report when clear of weather, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向右偏航 20 海里，脱离天气后报告，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: you have encountered severe clear air turbulence between 10,400 meters and 6000 meters, contact Zhengzhou Control and request climb to a higher level.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在 10,400 米至 6000 米之间遭遇严重晴空颠簸，联系郑州管制并请求爬升至更高高度。
cards.referenceText: Zhengzhou Control, UAL 811, we have encountered severe clear air turbulence between 1400 meters and 6000 meters, request climb to a higher level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 郑州管制，UAL 811，我们在 1400 米至 6000 米之间遭遇严重晴空颠簸，请求爬升至更高高度。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, climb to and maintain 11000 meters.
cards.referenceText: Climb to and maintain 11000 meters, UAL 811.

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 811, reduce speed to mach decimal 72.
B: Advise Zhengzhou Control mach decimal 72 is not acceptable, it's too low for your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： UAL 811，将速度减至 Mach 0.72。
B： 通知郑州管制，Mach 0.72 不可接受，对你的航空器而言太低。
cards.referenceText: negative, mach decimal seven two is too low (for our aircraft), UAL 811
cards.referenceTextZh: 不行，Mach 0.72太低（对我们的航空器而言），UAL 811。

cards.audioText: UAL 811, maintain mach decimal 75, we are limiting the number of aircraft flying through Wuhan Control area due to Wuhan radar failure.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 811，保持 Mach 0.75，因武汉雷达故障，我们正在限制飞越武汉管制区的航空器数量。

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 811, what is your estimated time for OBLIK?
B: Inform Zhengzhou Control your estimated time for OBLIK is 1152Z time.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：UAL 811，你预计到达 OBLIK 的时间是多少？
B：告知郑州管制预计 1152Z 到达 OBLIK。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 1200.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 1200。
cards.referenceText: Make an orbit right, reach OBLIK not earlier than 1200, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 右盘旋，抵达 OBLIK 不早于 1200，UAL 811。

cards.audioText: you are over OBLIK at time 1200Z, maintaining 11,000 meters, you are estimating ZF at time 1230, your next waypoint is WUH, make a standard position report to Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你在 1200Z 时飞越 OBLIK，保持 11,000 米，预计 1230 时到达 ZF，下一个航路点是 WUH，向武汉管制作标准位置报告。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, UAL 811, OBLIK1200Z, 2000 meters, estimating ZF1230 Z, WUH next.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉管制，UAL 811，1200Z 飞越 OBLIK，2000 米，预计 1230Z 到达 ZF，下一个航路点 WUH。

cards.audioText: UAL 811, Wuhan Control, roger, maintain 11,000 meters, report ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: UAL 811，武汉管制，收到，保持 11,000 米，到达 ZF 时报告。

cards.audioText: C: UAL 811, for identification, reset squawk 3572.
C: UAL 811, radar contact, omit position reports, resume own navigation to ZF.
cards.audioTextZh: C：UAL 811，雷达识别，可以省略位置报告，自主导航至 ZF。
cards.referenceText: Omit position reports, resume own navigation to ZF, UAL 811.
cards.referenceTextZh: 省略位置报告，自主导航至 ZF，UAL 811。
